Vulnerability Management

रिमीडिएशन प्लान

A documented set of actions, responsibilities, and timelines designed to resolve identified cryptographic or PKI vulnerabilities and achieve compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

A documented set of actions, responsibilities, and timelines designed to resolve identified cryptographic or PKI vulnerabilities and achieve compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Operational example

A remediation plan is mandatory for PKI compliance audits to ensure all cryptographic flaws are systematically addressed with clear deadlines and responsible parties.
